test_jaxpr_info_with_modules: test that all Haiku modules work with jaxpr_info by generating model info and HTML output
run_make_model_info: run jaxpr_info.make_model_info on a Haiku apply function to extract model expressions and structure
generate_html_from_model_info: generate an HTML page from a Haiku model info object using jaxpr_info.as_html_page
test_transform_with_state: test a Haiku module using hk.transform_with_state to initialize params and state before applying
review_jaxpr_info_expressions: review the expressions extracted by jaxpr_info to verify model structure for non-Sequential modules
